# What P(Doom)1 reaches for

**GENERATED by `tools/generate_trust_declaration.py` -- do not hand-edit.**
Regenerate after touching anything under `godot/scripts/` or
`godot/autoload/`; a pre-commit `--check` blocks a stale page.

## Read this first: what this page is not

**This does not prove the game is safe, and it is not a security audit.**
Nobody can prove the absence of vulnerabilities, and a page claiming to
would deserve less trust, not more.

What it is: an enumeration, taken from the source code, of every point
where the game reaches outside its own process -- with file and line, so
you can check each one yourself rather than believe this page.

Two further limits, stated plainly:

- It describes the **source**, not the binary you downloaded. What ties
  those together is the sha256 in each release's `release_manifest.json`
  and, once it exists, the Authenticode signature. See
  `docs/release/CODE_SIGNING.md`.
- A URL assembled at runtime from pieces would not appear here. Absence
  below means **not found by this scan**, never **does not happen**.

## Network: every host in the source

| host | why | referenced at |
|---|---|---|
| `aisafety.info` | an outbound link the player can click | `godot/scripts/ui/game_over_screen.gd:213`, `godot/scripts/ui/welcome_screen.gd:165` |
| `analytics.pdoom1.com` | anonymous install ping (opt-out, see below) | `godot/autoload/update_check.gd:9` |
| `github.com` | release downloads and the issue tracker | `godot/autoload/update_check.gd:5`, `godot/autoload/update_check.gd:7`, `godot/autoload/update_check.gd:8`, `godot/scripts/core/bug_reporter.gd:233` |
| `pdoom1.com` | version feed and public pages | `godot/autoload/update_check.gd:6`, `godot/scripts/ui/bug_report_panel.gd:95`, `godot/scripts/ui/bug_report_panel.gd:96`, `godot/scripts/ui/credits_screen.gd:6` |

### Declared by hand, because the scan cannot see them

A host whose URL is assembled at runtime leaves no literal in the source.
Listing only what a `grep` finds would understate the answer, so these are
declared deliberately, each with the reason the scan misses it.

- **`api.pdoom1.com`** -- leaderboard score submission and board fetch. NOT found by the scan: `leaderboard_sync.gd` reads its base URL from a config file at runtime, so no literal appears in the source. Sends only what a submitted score row contains, and only when remote sync is BOTH configured and enabled -- `enabled` defaults to false, so an unconfigured build never contacts it.

The game **runs fully offline.** Every network call is asynchronous with a
hard 3-second timeout, and any failure -- offline, timeout, bad JSON, HTTP
error -- is a silent no-op. Nothing blocks startup or play.

### The install ping, in full

The only thing the game sends unprompted is a Plausible analytics event
carrying a **random UUIDv4** stored in `user://install_id.txt`.

- It is **never derived** from your hardware, username, IP-as-identity, or
  anything else about your machine. It regenerates on reinstall, so it
  counts installs -- it is not a device fingerprint.
- It is **gated behind the in-game privacy opt-outs.**
- Nothing else is collected.

The update check itself sends **no identifier at all**, which is why it
does not sit behind the opt-out: there is nothing to opt out of.

## Files: what it writes, and where

| location | meaning | written at |
|---|---|---|
| `variable -- see line` | path built at runtime; check the line | `godot/autoload/achievements.gd:161`, `godot/autoload/error_handler.gd:151`, `godot/autoload/error_handler.gd:195`, `godot/autoload/error_handler.gd:197`, `godot/autoload/event_service.gd:166` |

**The game writes nothing outside its own user-data directory.** It
installs no service, adds no startup entry, touches no registry key, and
modifies no file it did not create. Uninstalling is deleting the folder
you extracted, plus that user-data directory if you want the saves gone.

## Process and OS reach

| call | what it means | at |
|---|---|---|
| `OS.execute` | runs a subprocess | `godot/scripts/core/build_info.gd:64`, `godot/scripts/core/build_info.gd:72` |
| `OS.shell_open` | asks your OS to open a URL or folder -- only ever after you click something | `godot/autoload/log_exporter.gd:110`, `godot/autoload/screenshot_manager.gd:69`, `godot/scripts/ui/bug_report_panel.gd:67`, `godot/scripts/ui/bug_report_panel.gd:73`, `godot/scripts/ui/credits_screen.gd:143` |

**On `OS.execute`, because it is the one that should make you look**:
the only use is reading the current git commit for the build badge,
and it is guarded on a `.git` existing beside the project directory.
A downloaded build has no `.git`, so **in a shipped build it never
runs at all.** Check `godot/scripts/core/build_info.gd` and see.

## How to check any of this yourself

The source is public. Every claim above is a `grep` away:

```
git clone https://github.com/PipFoweraker/pdoom1
grep -rn "https://" godot/scripts godot/autoload --include=*.gd
grep -rn "OS.execute\|OS.shell_open" godot/scripts godot/autoload
```

If you find something this page does not list, that is a defect in the
page and worth reporting -- in game, press **N**.
